column1: # One row per review round. Tab-separated fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), unit, round (continuous per unit across its
# proposal and implementation reviews), classes raised (comma-separated, or - when none), classes that repeated a prior
# round (comma-separated, or - when none), compliance_misses (findings that were a miss of an existing rule), the
# reviewer's session identifier (compared with surrounding whitespace trimmed), the session transition (created,
# continued, or replaced), and a replacement's reason (expired, definition-changed, stopped-responding, or
# caller-restarted; - otherwise). `caller-restarted` records a continuity violation already committed — the caller
# started a different session without an evidenced recovery case — not a permitted recovery case; the three recovery
# reasons stay unchanged.
# The last three fields are validated from the boundary comment below down, which marks the first row to carry them;
# the rows above it predate the fields, so they are exempt. `commit-hygiene.py --session-continuity` is that check.
# A gap whose report was never reconstructed is acknowledged by a comment line of the form
# `# --- Acknowledged gap: <unit> round <N> - <reason>`, which `commit-hygiene.py --unique-rounds` exempts —
# and only that pair. The same form acknowledges a historical number assigned incorrectly to a deep-review pass whose
# authoritative record moved to the change's review task; it then also names that destination and creates no data row.
# Appended by the main agent from the record line a review round emits; aggregated in the window by
# scripts/review-rounds.py, which the digest's review-rounds block prints.
# Classes come from the canonical list the reviewer's contract carries (`.opencode/agent/review-quick.md`), which makes
# the repeat column and the aggregation comparable; rows recorded before that list landed keep the labels they were
# recorded with, and the mapping from them — recorded in the archived canonical-class-list change's design — is applied
# by scripts/review-rounds.py.
# --- Acknowledged gap: separate-agents-md-core-and-subject-packs round 42 — the round's report was never
#     reconstructed, so the row cannot be written; `commit-hygiene.py --unique-rounds` exempts only this pair.
# --- Session continuity: from here down every row carries the reviewer's session identifier, its transition, and a
# --- replacement's reason; commit-hygiene.py --session-continuity validates them.
# --- Acknowledged gap: projector-operability round 11 - misfiled deep pass 1; see tasks.md, review-record-restoration.
# --- Acknowledged gap: projector-operability round 14 - misfiled deep pass 2; see tasks.md, review-record-restoration.
# Correction: projector-operability rounds 9,12,13,15 were labelled expired incorrectly; reasons corrected to
# caller-restarted from the caller's account. See tasks.md, review-record-restoration.
